messages:
mira: Quick follow-up from yesterday's token validation incident. Pulled the postmortem into the doc (https://redwood.internal/postmortems/token-validation-mar2026) — need concrete owners/ETAs for the remediation checklist and to lock verification windows. Please ack and add your ETA inline.

mira: Summary of required actions: 1) update ops runbook and add regression tests, 2) restrict service-account permissions, 3) enable structured audit fields + bump retention, 4) rotate affected secrets, 5) schedule a 7-day verification window with automated alerts. Proposed owners/timelines below — adjust if needed.

mira: Proposed plan:
- Runbook + regression tests (owner: @devon) — 3 business days
- Permission scoping + canary rollout (owner: @anjali) — 5 business days
- Audit logging schema + retention (owner: @mira) — 2 business days
- Secrets rotation for svc-account-* (owner: @sam) — 1 business day + smoke checks
- 7-day verification & nightly regression job (owners: @devon/@mira) — verification window starts after cutover

devon: Ack, I’ll take runbook/tests. I want an automated test that covers: expired token, tampered signature, and TTL drift edge-case. Plan: add `integration/auth_token_regress` and a nightly CI job for 7 days post-rollout. ETA: 3 business days. :white_check_mark:

anjali: Ack for permission scoping. I'll produce an RBAC delta (least-privilege bindings) and a canary that routes 10% of auth checks to the new policy with fallback to old policy on error spike. Question: do we want a static 10% or progressive (10->30->100)? leaning progressive. ETA: 5 business days.

sam: I’ll do the key rotation. My plan: create new key version, deploy as shadow secret, run shadow validation against a subset of traffic, then cutover and revoke old key after 24h. Will include exact commands in the runbook. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

mira: For audit logs, enable structured fields: {actor, svc_account, token_id, op, outcome, region, svc_version}. Temporarily increase retention to 90d for these events and export to internal analytics to run pattern detection queries. I’ll push the config change.

devon: Note — add a CI assertion for token validation metrics: fail if `token_validation_failure_rate` increases >0.2% vs baseline during canary. Also add a synthetic that calls `validate` with known-bad tokens.

anjali: Canary details: I’ll implement progressive ramp with automatic pause/rollback if failure rate delta > 0.5% sustained for 10m or absolute failures > 50 requests in 5m. Will document rollback procedure.

sam: Draft rotation commands I’ll add to the runbook:
```
# create new key
infractl keys create --svc svc-account-billing --out key_v2.json
# stage as secret version
secretsctl put --name svc-account-billing --file key_v2.json --version v2
# shadow validate using new key
for id in $(seq 1 100); do curl -s -X POST https://auth.internal/validate -d '{"token":"$NEW"}'; done
# cutover to v2 if shadow checks pass
secretsctl promote --name svc-account-billing --version v2
# revoke old after 24h
secretsctl revoke --name svc-account-billing --version v1 --after 24h
```

mira: Good. I'll also create #incident-token-verify for the 7-day verification window and add owners. Deploy-bot — any scheduling notes for the audit config?

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: audit-log-schema v3 scheduled 2026-03-28T03:00Z. No downtime expected. (id: dpl_20260328_009)

devon: One more item — I've seen TTL drift show up in 2 other incidents last quarter. Can we add a short telemetry check to look for systematic skew (token_issue_time vs token_expiry anomalies by region)? If correlated, escalate to infra.

mira: Agreed. @anjali can you run a quick query across the last 30 days and post findings in 48h? @sam please verify host time sync on the affected fleet (chrony/ntp) and report.

anjali: I’ll run the query and post results by EOD +2 days.

sam: Running `chronyc tracking` on the fleet now and will report any hosts >500ms drift. ETA: tomorrow morning.

mira: Thanks. Final ask: add your final ETA into the postmortem doc and create the JIRA tasks (labels: incident-token-validation, postmortem-remediation). I’ll assign verification duty and invite owners to #incident-token-verify once audit deploy completes.

devon: Added JIRA tasks and pushed the test branch.

anjali: RBAC delta PR opened (WIP), will add canary config.

sam: Rotation draft posted in #eng-ops.

mira: Closing loop — will post when audit logging config is live. Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone. :heart:
